item.title: Ruston responds with Airline win Tuesday
item.description: By Kyle Roberts RUSTON, La. — Ruston High (5-4) got a bounce-back run-rule win Tuesday night on the road at Airline (3-7) by a final score of 12-2 thanks in large part to a four-RBI performance by junior JP Moak at the plate. “Man, we needed that to start a tough five-game stretch on the … Continue reading Ruston responds with Airline win Tuesday
